# Croud

> Global media, creative, and data agency specializing in performance marketing, AI-driven insights, and luxury brand digital strategy.

Croud offers integrated marketing services through its proprietary CroudOS and BrandCI platforms, with specialized expertise in luxury retail, ecommerce optimization, and data-driven advertising. The agency provides insights on emerging trends including AI search, cookie deprecation, and cross-channel attribution.

## Key Topics

- AI marketing and ChatGPT integration
- Luxury brand digital strategy
- Cookie deprecation and first-party data
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Croud Consumer Index research
- Cross-channel attribution
- TikTok and Instagram marketing
- Online marketplaces and ecommerce
- Privacy Sandbox and data privacy
- Predictive analytics
- Social media as search engines
- Video marketing and creative content
- Localization and global marketing
- Performance marketing platforms

## Core Services & Platform

- [Croud UK | Global media, creative & data agency](https://croud.com/en-gb): UK homepage for global media agency featuring CroudOS & BrandCI platform
- [Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) | Croud US](https://croud.com/en-us/services/commerce-suite/conversion-rate-optimisation-cro): CRO services offering A/B testing, personalization & experimentation
- [Resources | Croud](https://croud.com/resources): Resource hub for digital marketing news, reports, and Croud insights
- [First Watch case study | Croud](https://croud.com/en-us/work/first-watch): Restaurant website redesign with Wisely API & OLO ordering integration

## AI & Search Innovation

- [The Croud Consumer Index: AI, LLMs and the Next Frontier of Search](https://croud.com/resources/croud-consumer-index-ai-llms-and-the-next-frontier-of-search): Consumer research on AI's impact on brand discovery via ChatGPT & Gemini
- [ChatGPT, AI and Google: Croud's take](https://croud.com/resources/chatgpt-ai-and-google-crouds-take): Croud's analysis of ChatGPT, OpenAI, and Google's AI search evolution
- [How Social Media Platforms Are Fast Becoming the Next Search Engines | Croud](https://croud.com/resources/how-social-media-platforms-are-fast-becoming-the-next-search-engines): Analysis of TikTok & Instagram as Gen Z search alternatives to Google
- [ChatGPT and localisation - friend or foe? | Croud](https://croud.com/resources/chatgpt-and-localisation-friend-or-foe): Global consumer trust in ChatGPT for translation & content localization

## Data Strategy & Privacy

- [Google's cookie U-turn: Croud's POV](https://croud.com/resources/googles-cookie-u-turn-crouds-pov): Croud's perspective on Chrome cookie changes & Privacy Sandbox strategy
- [First-party data lead generation tactics for luxury brands | Croud](https://croud.com/resources/first-party-data-lead-generation-tactics-for-luxury-brands): Lead generation tactics for luxury brands amid cookie deprecation
- [Taking on the media silos | Croud](https://croud.com/resources/media-silos): Breaking media silos with cross-channel tracking & attribution strategy
- [Leveraging predictive analytics to help revive your ecommerce | Croud](https://croud.com/resources/predictive-analytics-ecommerce): Using machine learning & customer segmentation for ecommerce growth

## Luxury Brand Marketing
